source_uri_or_access_instructions: Obtain the four v1.12.1 CSVs described below
Run the DIG acquisition command from an independent accession snapshot
Set GLYGEN_UNICARBKB_CSV to the GlyGen v1.12.1 CSV
Set GLYGEN_HARVARD_CSV to the GlyGen v1.12.1 CSV
Set GLYGEN_GLYCONNECT_CSV to the GlyGen v1.12.1 CSV
Set GLYGEN_PROTEIN_MASTERLIST_CSV to the GlyGen v1.12.1 masterlist
Set GLYGEN_GLYCAN_ACCESSIONS_TSV to an independent GlyTouCan accession snapshot
Set GLYGEN_API_CACHE_MANIFEST_TSV to a manifest made by the DIG acquisition command
